audit.policy: fixed 512 proposals per requested family; variants cycle by proposal index; no replacement; construction for every family finishes before the first portfolio fit
audit.independentChallenger: postponed until versioned export; B4r builder audit only, no freeze
audit.dependence: four requested-family audits reuse the same 512 seed values; rows within a world are dependent; no pooled independent interval

portfolio.selector: highest public training accuracy; ties by registration order; chosen before sealed scoring
portfolio.workAccounting: Wall-clock per stage is comparable. Search counters are member-specific and not comparable across members. Fit includes catalogue, feature and model preparation. Runtime/context creation, source loading, state parsing and serialization are included in stage wall-clock. WASM module initialization is reported separately.
portfolio.memoization: none: each row gets a fresh runtime and context; public, challenge and natural each have a separate equal inference budget
portfolio.preparation: standalone estimate = measured cold module initialization + fit; actual module initialization is separately charged when incurred; amortized = fit per world with a reused interpreter module, never reused solver state
